settings.title: GitLab instance URL
settings.description: The GitLab instance to read Review Requests from, for example https://gitlab.com or https://gitlab.example.com.

settings.title: glab path
settings.description: The full path of the glab command, for example /opt/homebrew/bin/glab. Blank looks for it on PATH and in the usual install folders (/opt/homebrew/bin, /usr/local/bin, ~/.local/bin).

settings.title: Overdue after (working hours)
settings.description: A Review Request waiting longer than this, counting Monday to Friday only, is marked overdue.

settings.title: Only these groups or projects
settings.description: Group or project paths, separated by commas, spaces or new lines, for example acme/backend or acme/*/api (* is one path segment). A path matches itself and everything below it; case does not matter. Empty means all.

settings.title: Never these groups or projects
settings.description: Group or project paths, written like the allowlist. A Review Request matching one is hidden, even if the allowlist matches it, unless it already has a review workspace.

settings.title: Never these authors
settings.description: GitLab usernames, separated by commas, spaces or new lines, for example renovate-bot or @dependabot.

settings.title: Review agent
settings.description: The Orca agent that runs an Agent Review, for example claude or codex.

settings.title: Review Prompt
settings.description: The prompt that starts an Agent Review. Placeholders: {mrUrl}, {title}, {project}, {sourceBranch}, {targetBranch}, {baseRef} (origin/<target branch>, the Review Workspace's base), {author}.
settings.default: Review the GitLab merge request {mrUrl} ("{title}" by {author}, {sourceBranch} into {targetBranch}) in {project}. The workspace has the MR's head checked out. Read .orca-review/merge-request.md for the MR's description and context; if that file is missing, read the description on GitLab. Review the MR's changes as `git diff {baseRef}...HEAD`. Don't post anything to GitLab. Write your findings to .orca-review/findings.json as JSON like `{"headSha": "<output of git rev-parse HEAD>", "findings": [{"path": "src/file.ts", "line": 42, "body": "What is wrong and how to fix it."}, {"body": "A comment on the merge request as a whole."}]}`. "line" is the line in the new version of the file; add "startLine" for a range of lines.

settings.title: Custom review command
settings.description: Optional. A command to run in the review workspace instead of launching the review agent, for example claude --model opus {prompt}. {prompt} is the filled Review Prompt; the Review Prompt's placeholders work too.

settings.title: Remove ended review workspaces after (days)
settings.description: Clean workspaces of Ended Review Requests are removed after this many days. 0 turns it off.
